Did I Buy A Lemon? Lucid Is Buying My Car Back After 11 Months.
After just 11 months, Lucid is buying my car back entirely. When I originally got my 2025 Lucid Air Touring, my plan was to lease it for three years, then decide whether to buy it out or give it back. I didn’t even make it a year, until signing a document that basically says "this offer is intended to provide you, at a minimum, with what you may be entitled to under 'lemon law.'"
